prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 41.2 °C (33% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 45.8 °C (27% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.9 °C (23% above healthy). Heat exchanger effectiveness has dropped below optimal threshold, producing elevated mean temperatures.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.63 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 371 W·min/l (3% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Circuit pressure ripple is minimal and peak buffering operates at optimal baseline.
